body.p: is a free, open-source, cross-platform audio editor and recorder. It runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux, making it one of the most accessible audio editing tools available.

ul.li: Record live audio through a microphone or mixer
Import and export audio in many formats (WAV, MP3, OGG, FLAC)
Edit audio with cut, copy, paste, and delete
Apply effects like noise reduction, equalization, and compression

body.p: Whether you are recording a podcast, digitizing vinyl records, or editing sound effects for a video, provides the tools you need — at no cost.
